title: Open Reconciliation Wizard in Ledgers
description: Complete the open reconciliation wizard workflow in the Ledgers module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with accountant access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Ledgers module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for open reconciliation wizard are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Ledgers module from the main navigation.
Locate the open reconciliation wizard entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for open reconciliation wizard.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Open Reconciliation Wizard completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Ledgers views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during open reconciliation wizard.
Permission constraints prevent completion of open reconciliation wizard.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun open reconciliation wizard.
Confirm role permissions for accountant and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun open reconciliation wizard?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm open reconciliation wizard is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
